purpose: Make CI modes explicit so that marking tests @pytest.mark.slow does not silently remove coverage from release assurance.

critical_current_state.verified: Both baseline arms ran with deselected=0 and passed=5213, which includes the 7 slow tests. Coverage is NOT currently being lost.

FAST.purpose: Inner-loop gate. Excludes real-multiprocess stress tests.

STRESS.purpose: Race/TOCTOU stress: real spawned OS processes, 8-16 workers x 50 rounds.
STRESS.use_for: pre-release and after any writer-lock or concurrency change

FULL.measured_duration_sec: 1157.59 - 1607.46 across two runs on a loaded host
FULL.purpose: Authoritative release gate. Includes stress tests. This is the DEFAULT and must be what release assurance relies on.

required_cadence.STRESS: every release candidate, and mandatory whenever writer_lock, subprocess supervision, atomic publication, or concurrency code changes
required_cadence.FULL: every release candidate, before any evidence regeneration or push
required_cadence.rationale_for_STRESS_frequency: These tests exist to catch TOCTOU and spawn races (GAP-024, GAP-028). Their value is entirely in being run; a fast-only gate would leave those defects undetectable.

anti_silencing_guarantees: No test was deleted, skipped by default, or had its assertion weakened.
The 7 slow tests are counted in the FULL mode total (5213) - they are partitioned, not removed.
addopts deliberately contains NO -m filter, so a bare pytest run is always the complete suite.
Any future change that introduces an -m filter into pytest.ini addopts must be accompanied by an update to this document and to PYTEST_BASELINE_COMPARISON.json.

marker_annotations_restored_this_wave.note: The @pytest.mark.slow annotations were corrupted by C# source injected into the function-def lines. Restored from HEAD and correctly re-applied to these 5 tests.

host_caveat: Stress-suite duration is highly sensitive to CPU contention. On this host a live cook plus its shader workers inflated the FULL suite from 1158 s to 1607 s with identical outcomes. Stress-mode results should be taken on an otherwise idle machine.
